limitations: Use v1.1 only; related v1.0 ortho-parallax change products were retracted.
The deposition/erosion polygon files in this release are downstream Syabrubesi features and do not cover the port-core reach.
The reach-A registered product reports about 3.2 m stable-ground median alignment error, a corrected +1.75 m flat-ground bias, and cloud-limited coverage.
Do not directly subtract these EGM2008 products from the local ellipsoidal-height DEMs.
